projectDescription: An AI-powered sales automation tool that finds, scores, and contacts business prospects through LinkedIn and email on a configurable schedule.
keyFeatures: AI-powered ICP scoring (0–100) with structured criteria and relative weights
Multi-channel outreach via LinkedIn and email with configurable sequencing
Per-seat scheduling, daily action limits, and delivery mode controls
Automated follow-up sequences (up to 3 email + 1 LinkedIn follow-up)
Approval workflow — review, edit, regenerate, or reject messages before send
Next run queue dashboard showing real-time pipeline forecasts
Cross-channel reply detection that stops automation on both channels
Blacklist for customers, competitors, partners, and active deals
Credits system for contact search and enrichment work
LinkedIn hygiene safeguards including pacing, warm-up, and session management
publicApiSurface: Settings → Schedule (run time, daily limits, channel behavior, delivery mode)
Settings → Blacklist (company name and domain exclusions)
Add to Pipeline (Sales Navigator URLs, CSV upload, company contact search)
Home → Next run (queue cards: connection requests, messages, outreach, follow-ups)
Activity (run status: started, succeeded, skipped, stopped, failed)
